Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference

Constants

This section describes the constants that identify the various terminal, directory number, and call appearance messages. You use these constants to identify which messages a telephone tool supports and to specify which messages you want your message handler to receive. This section also describes the constants used by various Telephone Manager functions.
IMPORTANT
To receive messages, you must create and register message handling routines. For information on how to write a message handling routine, see "Application-Defined Message Functions" on page 5-56.
